bugs_found: compound_interest silently truncates non-integer years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without validation
loan_payment silently truncates non-integer months via int(), changing repayment amounts without validation
transfer does not coerce or validate amount as Decimal/finite, so mixed numeric types or NaN-like Decimal values can raise late or corrupt balances
fx_convert does not validate FX rate is positive and finite, allowing zero, negative, NaN, or Infinity rates to produce invalid monetary amounts
compound_interest does not validate principal is non-negative or finite, allowing nonsensical balances/results
